name: verify-oxsum-bill
description: Verify oxsum bills, statements and usage reports entirely in the browser — recomputes entry hashes, links them to the ledger head, and refolds each committed subset, with no server round-trip.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const w='wasm/verify_wasm.js';if(!fs.existsSync(w)||fs.statSync(w).size===0){console.error('wasm/ is empty — run scripts/build-verify-wasm.sh first so the tarball ships the module the loader imports');process.exit(1)}"
